items.name: Pulse
items.impact: Risk of OOM kills and restart loops, degraded application responsiveness.
recommendation: Raise the container memory limit if the host has capacity.
Redistribute applications across hosts or add an App Host.
items.best_practice: Keep application memory usage below 80% of the limit.

items.name: ThreatIntel
items.observation: Container restarted 14 times; Installed 3.1.0 - latest available 3.2.0
items.impact: Intermittent or failed application availability and consumption of host CPU/IO by crash loops.
recommendation: Inspect container logs and 'docker inspect' for exit codes (137 = OOM kill).
Increase the application memory allocation (Admin > Apps > Manage > Resources) or move the app to a host with more RAM.
Update to the latest app release and raise a support case with logs if the loop continues.
items.best_practice: Review application resource consumption regularly and size the App Host according to the app sizing guide.
